newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs well supported ahead French poll news.
newsitem.headline: OLOs well supported ahead French poll news.

text.p: Belgian government bonds (OLOs) and futures are seen having little downside this week despite nervousness over the possible fallout from French elections on the EMU project and over a U.S. interest rate hike further out.
Prices held steady on Tuesday after buying levels were hit in Monday's selloff on a surprise lead for the combined Left in Sunday's first round of parliamentary elections in France.

Dealers said the market was supported by expectations that an estimated 70 billion francs of cash resulting from an OLO redemption was still looking for a home and by recent spates of buying on dips by those focusing on sound fundamentals.
